album: The Nocturnal Architectures of Memory – Nuit du Songe
excerpt: In Nuit du Songe, Sherif Dahroug constructs a nocturnal sonic architecture suspended between memory, colour, fragrance and ritual perception. Conceived as a constellation of nine interconnected instrumental tableaux, the album unfolds less as a sequence of compositions than as a single continuous state of listening, where sound becomes an inhabitable space of resonance and inner transformation. Written for piano, prepared piano, church bells, vocal textures and hybrid instrumental sonorities, the work explores a musical territory situated between contemporary classical composition, timbral experimentation and contemplative sound art.
